requirement_review.finding: 'GST on declared tariff' does not say whether weekend/peak surcharges or the extra bed change the declared tariff. A SUITE at ₹7,500 on a Saturday is ₹9,000 actually charged but declared ₹7,500 → 5 % or 18 %?
requirement_review.resolution: Clarified with product owner (team decision): slab is chosen on the base tariff + extra bed, before surcharges and discounts. Captured as test TC-PRC-BVA-008/009 and TC-SYS-FN-002.

requirement_review.finding: 'No cancellation after the stay starts' — is the arrival day itself 'started'?
requirement_review.resolution: Arrival day (0 days before) is still cancellable under the 0–1 day band; cancellation is refused from the day after arrival (days_before < 0). Tested by TC-CAN-BVA-001/002.

requirement_review.finding: Weekend surcharge rule did not define which nights are 'weekend'.
requirement_review.resolution: A night is a weekend night when it starts on Friday or Saturday (hotel industry convention). ECP cases TC-PRC-ECP-013..019.

requirement_review.finding: Order of applying promo vs. 30 % cap unspecified; promo could exceed the cap on its own.
requirement_review.resolution: Cap applies to the sum of all discounts including the promo. Property TC-PBT-002.

requirement_review.finding: 'Account locked for 15 minutes' — counter reset behaviour after lock expiry not stated.
requirement_review.resolution: Counter resets when the lock is applied and on every successful sign-in. Decision table TC-AUTH-DT-001..006.

requirement_review.finding: How guests are distributed across multiple rooms was not specified.
requirement_review.resolution: Adults spread evenly (each room ≥ 1 adult); children fill remaining capacity in order. TC-INT-021/022.

requirement_review.finding: Original wording 'system should be fast' was not measurable.
requirement_review.resolution: Rewritten as p95 < 300 ms and < 1 % errors at 25 concurrent users (SMART); verified by the load test.

code_inspection.finding: Dynamic UPDATE built with an f-string (Bandit B608 / Ruff S608).
code_inspection.decision: Values were parameterised; hardened with a column allow-list (SA-01). Test TC-INT-025.

code_inspection.finding: free_rooms builds an IN (?,?,?) list with an f-string (Bandit B608).
code_inspection.decision: False positive: only '?' placeholders are interpolated; all values bound. Kept with justification.
False positive: idiomatic FastAPI dependency injection.
Route closures inside the factory inflate the metric; each route body has CC ≤ 2. Accepted; refactor to APIRouter recommended.

code_inspection.finding: Exception names NotFound/Forbidden lack 'Error' suffix (Ruff N818).
code_inspection.decision: Style only; kept for readability of handlers.
Linear list of independent checks, each covered by ECP + branch tests; acceptable.

manual_cases.title: Nielsen heuristic walkthrough of the booking page (visibility of status, error prevention, recognition over recall)
manual_cases.steps: Two evaluators independently score the 10 heuristics 0–4 on the booking page; merge findings.
manual_cases.tester: Evaluator 1: Claude (AI assistant, tool-assisted) · Evaluator 2: second evaluator (pending)
manual_cases.environment: Chromium 141 · 1280×900 desktop and 375×812 mobile · signed-in guest
manual_cases.actual: Evaluator 1 scored all 10 heuristics; highest severity 2 (minor) — no heuristic ≥ 3. Six usability observations logged (UX-01..UX-06). Expected result met for evaluator 1; case closes when evaluator 2 has scored independently and findings are merged.
heuristic_scores: H1 Visibility of system status
Every action reports into a status region; header shows the internal tier code "(NONE)" after sign-in (UX-01).
H2 Match with the real world
Booking form's Room type list shows codes (DELUXE) while the cards say "Deluxe Room" (UX-02).
H3 User control and freedom
No sign-out control; the sign-in panel stays on screen after signing in (UX-03). Bookings can be cancelled.
H4 Consistency and standards
Same naming mismatch as H2; buttons, colours and messages otherwise consistent.
H5 Error prevention
Date pickers allow past and reversed dates (no min / dependent min); the error appears only after Search (UX-04).
H6 Recognition rather than recall
Cards show price for the stay incl. GST and rooms left; Select carries the room into the booking form.
H7 Flexibility and efficiency of use
No shortcut to re-book or remember the last search; acceptable for scope.
H8 Aesthetic and minimalist design
Clean single-page layout; works at 375 px with no horizontal scroll.
H9 Help users recognise and recover from errors
Plain-language messages next to the form ("Check-out must be after check-in").
H10 Help and documentation
Refund rules are not shown when choosing Flexible vs Saver rate (UX-05).
observations: Header shows internal tier code "(NONE)" for guests with no loyalty tier
Room type select shows codes instead of the names used on the cards
No sign-out; sign-in panel remains after sign-in
Date fields accept past / reversed dates until submit (add min and dependent min)
Cancellation/refund rules not visible at the rate choice
My bookings action column header is display:none, so it is announced as an empty header (use a visually-hidden label)

manual_cases.title: Amounts shown in Indian grouping with ₹ symbol (₹1,23,456.00)
manual_cases.steps: Quote a long FAMILY stay; inspect totals.
manual_cases.expected: en-IN lakh grouping and two decimals
manual_cases.environment: Chromium 141, locale en-IN; FAMILY ×2 rooms, 4 adults, 1→31 Dec 2026 (30 nights, maximum stay)
manual_cases.actual: Quote shows Subtotal ₹4,18,800.00 · Discount ₹62,820.00 · GST ₹17,799.00 · Total ₹3,73,779.00. All 4 amounts use ₹, Indian lakh grouping (x,xx,xxx) and exactly two decimals; two amounts are ≥ ₹1 lakh.

manual_cases.title: Date pickers respect browser locale (DD/MM/YYYY on en-IN)
manual_cases.steps: Set browser locale en-IN; open date fields.
manual_cases.expected: Locale-appropriate format; ISO sent to API
manual_cases.environment: Chromium 141 started with --lang=en-IN and, as control, --lang=en-US
manual_cases.actual: en-IN: fields display DD/MM/YYYY (15/11/2026); en-US: MM/DD/YYYY. Both send ISO dates to the API: GET /api/availability?check_in=2026-11-15&check_out=2026-11-18. Note: the display order follows the browser's UI language, not only the page's Accept-Language — a browser set to en-US shows MM/DD even for Indian users (native control behaviour, not an app defect).

manual_cases.title: Screen-reader pass with NVDA / VoiceOver
manual_cases.steps: Navigate sign-in, search and booking by screen reader only.
manual_cases.expected: All controls announced with labels; status messages announced
manual_cases.tester: Automated proxy: Claude (AI assistant, tool-assisted) · NVDA/VoiceOver pass: pending
manual_cases.environment: Chromium 141 accessibility tree (what a screen reader reads) + keyboard-only navigation
manual_cases.actual: Proxy checks pass: all 28 form controls have accessible names (0 unnamed); auth tabs are exposed as role=tab with selected state; 7 live/status regions; a failed sign-in ("Invalid email or password") lands in a role=status region, so it is announced; keyboard order follows the visual order. Findings: the bookings table's action column has an empty header (UX-06); the calendar button inside the date fields shows no focus ring. A real NVDA (Windows) or VoiceOver (macOS/iOS) pass is still needed to close the case.
